findings.title: Failed reload overwrites a previously valid cache entry with nil
findings.body: When GetWebAssets fails to load the manifest (result == nil, err != nil), line 69 unconditionally assigns entryPointAssetsCache = result (nil). In Dev mode, where reloads are attempted on every call, a transient read failure of assets-manifest.json discards a previously cached, still-valid *dtos.EntryPointAssets, so subsequent requests also fail until the file loads again. Consider only overwriting the cache when err == nil.

findings.title: Non-nil result can be returned together with a non-nil error
findings.body: In the CDN branch, readWebAssetsFromCDN can return both a non-nil dto and a non-nil error (e.g. if the HTTP request succeeds but SetContentDeliveryURL or a later step fails, or if the decoder returns partial data and an error). In that case the file-read fallback at line 59 is skipped (result != nil), and GetWebAssets returns a valid-looking result alongside an error. Callers that check err first will treat this as a failure, while callers that check the pointer will use a possibly malformed asset list. The code should decide on a single source of truth (either result or err) before caching and returning.
